purpose: Adoption record for single-exp softmax normalization on the decode attention path

baseline.description: Merged oct attend scoring, value-pass unroll, FP32 j-unroll

candidate.description: attendSingleExp computes exp once per position, stores e = exp(score-max) in scores, normalizes by invSum, and keeps the eight/four/scalar score pairing plus the four-element value unroll. Decode path only (attentionRange); the train/prefill attend keeps the two-exp form.
candidate.exactness: NOT bit-identical: p = e*invSum differs from exp(s-lse) by up to ~1.9e-08 absolute (~0.9% relative on near-zero elements). lse remains bit-identical. Adopted under the completion-identical standard: every measured completion is byte-identical.

drift.completions_identical: 5 synthetic generation shapes x 24 trials + real Llama-3.2-3B 128-token runs, all byte-identical

limitations: The drift values above describe the original fixture only, not a universal bound. Completion equality is not guaranteed for other prompts, models or sampling settings.

review_audit.scope_correction: attentionRange serves cached inference including chunked prefill, not exclusively single-token decode. Training and evaluation callers of attend are unchanged.

synthetic_evidence.status: Preserved local before/after sources differ only by package name and the single-exp normalization in shared attend. This validates the arithmetic experiment, not the exact later decode-only integration.
synthetic_evidence.protocol: GOMAXPROCS=4, five shapes, three warmups then 24 alternating paired trials; harness compares JSON-encoded completions and panics on mismatch. Sources and raw results are local ignored artifacts.

real_model_evidence.correction: The real-model reference is NOT the stated da30c89 baseline. Its dirty build predates that baseline. Preserve the 37.78/35.53 seconds as historical observations, but do not attribute their ratio to single-exp normalization alone.
real_model_evidence.command_arguments: generate -hf-model ~/SpiralReality/models/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct -weight-mib 14000 -prompt 'Write a detailed history of the city of Tokyo.' -max-tokens 128 -temperature 0 -threads 4

matched_baseline_completion_recheck.comparison: cmp succeeded on complete stdout from base and candidate, same model path and command_arguments as above. One greedy prompt, 128 tokens, threads=4. This is output validation only; no timing conclusion.
matched_baseline_completion_recheck.build: Go 1.27.3, CGO_ENABLED=0, go build -trimpath ./cmd/monolith; baseline built from detached da30c89 worktree.
matched_baseline_completion_recheck.availability: Raw outputs and binaries retained locally outside Git; hashes establish identity but do not make the model or raw data publicly available.

review_audit.production_test: TestExpReduceAttendDelta now directly exercises attendSingleExp against frozen octScoreAttend, including 8/4/scalar tails, finite outputs, identical LSE, and fixture tolerance abs(delta) <= 2e-7 + 2e-6*abs(reference). This tolerance is a regression guard for these fixtures, not a mathematical global bound.
